description: baseline

Replace the PyTorch QR path with a shape-specialized CUDA C++ tiled Householder/TSQR kernel family for QR_v2, fusing column norm, reflector/dot reductions, trailing update, and Q/R materialization to eliminate torch.linalg and Python-level launch overhead while improving SM occupancy.
single-block CUDA Householder QR extension builds but fails factor residual on dense/stress cases
correct single-block CUDA Householder passes official tests but is too slow for problem guards
hybrid CUDA Householder handles n<=176 while falling back to torch.geqrf for larger QR cases
route only n=32 through custom CUDA Householder; valid but slower because n=176 falls back
restore best hybrid route using CUDA Householder for n<=176
use 128-thread custom Householder blocks for n<=176; valid but below 256-thread best
restore best 256-thread hybrid CUDA Householder for n<=176

Best commit c0863aba keeps a hybrid CUDA C++ compact Householder path for n<=176 and torch.geqrf fallback for larger/stress cases; validation passed, benchmark geomean 108460.188 us vs 116349.465 baseline (~7.3% faster). Full custom all-shape path was correct but too slow for guards; n=32-only and 128-thread variants were valid but slower.

Target the n=352 mid-size gap with a separate CUDA C++ fast path using blocked Householder panels of small fixed width, shared memory for panel/tau/reduction scratch, and batched global-memory trailing updates, while preserving the existing n<=176 compact route and larger-n torch.geqrf fallback.
route n=352 through existing single-block CUDA Householder; valid but slower than torch fallback
parallel multi-launch CUDA n=352 path updates each trailing column per block while preserving n<=176 route and larger fallback
parallelize n=352 reflector vector scaling in the factor kernel, improving target shape latency
test 128-thread blocks for n=352 parallel path; valid but slower than 256-thread version
restore best 256-thread n=352 parallel path after block-size test
compile n=352 path without fast-math; valid but slower than fast-math best
restore best fast-math n=352 parallel scaling path

Best commit 97199151 adds a separate n=352 CUDA C++ path with per-column trailing-update launches and parallel reflector scaling, preserving n<=176 custom route and torch.geqrf fallback for larger cases. Validation/guards passed; best benchmark geomean 105642.112 us vs parent 108460.188 (~2.7% faster) and baseline 116349.465 (~10.1% faster). Direct n=352 single-block path, 128-thread blocks, and no-fast-math variants were valid but slower.

Redesign the n=352 CUDA QR path from 97199151 to eliminate per-column trailing-update launch storms by fusing multiple column updates per panel or using a persistent grid-stride update kernel while preserving the current combined dispatch behavior.
fused two-column n=352 update halves launches but corrupts factor residual from unsafe repeated block reductions
replace n=352 per-column launch storm with warp-per-column persistent update blocks over groups of 8 trailing columns
4-column grouping for n=352 persistent update incorrectly lets extra warps alias columns and fails residual
test 512-thread n=352 update grouping 16 columns per block; valid but slightly slower geomean
restore best 256-thread n=352 warp-per-column persistent update
use 384-thread n=352 warp-per-column update grouping 12 trailing columns per launch block

Best commit c33dc33d redesigns n=352 trailing updates into a warp-per-column persistent update kernel using 384-thread blocks over 12 trailing columns, preserving combined dispatch. Validation/guards passed; best benchmark geomean 99735.042 us vs parent 105642.112 (~5.9% faster) and baseline 116349.465 (~16.7% faster). A naive fused-two-column reduction and 4-column grouping failed validation; 8-column/256-thread and 16-column/512-thread variants were valid but slower.

Combine global best e061edeb with c33dc33: preserve e061 dispatch plus n=512 and n=4096 behavior, but replace its ba97 n=352 grouped update with c33's 384-thread, 12-trailing-column warp-per-column update. Target the n=352 memory/parallelism bottleneck only; avoid n=1024 and host dispatch tuning.
combine e061 dispatch with c33 384-thread 12-column n=352 warp update only

Best commit aa82f211 combines global best e061 dispatch and n512/n4096 behavior with c33's 384-thread, 12-column n=352 warp-per-column update only. Validation/guards passed; benchmark geomean 92459.101 us vs parent 105642.112 and baseline 116349.465. No further variants pursued because brief requested this exact combine and profiling was captured.

Profile only the n352 grouped-update path in the current c33/e061 winner and retune its 384-thread, 12-column warp update locally: compare 10/12/14 update columns, register pressure, shared-memory staging, and occupancy; preserve existing n512/n4096/small-n dispatch and avoid host dispatch or n1024 changes.
test 320-thread n=352 update grouping 10 columns; valid but slower than 12-column parent
test 448-thread n=352 update grouping 14 columns; valid but slower than 12-column parent

Micro-tuned the current aa82/e061/c33 n=352 grouped update only. Parent 12-column/384-thread path remains best at 92459.101 us. Tested 10-column/320-thread (93596.886 us) and 14-column/448-thread (92921.421 us); both passed validation/guards but were slower. Restored parent aa82f211 as HEAD; no n512/n4096/small-n/host dispatch changes kept.

Profile and locally tune only the existing n4096 structured upper/rank-deficient fast path, reducing output construction, tau allocation, and flag-reduction overhead without adding detector launches or changing other dispatch paths.
fuse batch1 n4096 upper detection with output/tau construction in one CUDA C++ launch; valid but no benchmark gain
specialize batch1 n4096 upper flag scan with shift/mask indexing; valid but slower overall

Brief 5 tuned only the n4096 structured upper fast path. Tested a fused detect+output/tau CUDA C++ launch (92611.689 us) and a specialized n4096 flag scan using shift/mask indexing (93038.708 us); both passed validation/guards but were slower than parent aa82f211 at 92459.101 us. Restored aa82f211 as HEAD and captured final nsys profile brief5-restored-aa82f211.

Profile aa82f211 custom-route output materialization overhead across existing n<=176, n352, n512 rankdef, and n4096 structured paths, then reduce only shared H/tau allocation, copy, zero-init, and compact Householder handoff costs using empty/empty_like choices and fused fill/copy kernels where safe; preserve every route predicate and algorithm.
vectorize n512 rankdef H/tau materialization with float4 copy/zero fill; valid but slower than parent
move n4096 upper H/tau allocation and output launch into C++ wrapper; valid but slower than parent

Brief 6 profiled and locally tuned materialization/handoff overhead only. Tested vectorized float4 n512 rankdef H/tau copy-zero materialization (92870.724 us) and moving n4096 upper H/tau allocation/output launch into a C++ wrapper (92946.455 us); both validated but were slower than parent aa82f211 at 92459.101 us. Restored aa82f211 as HEAD and captured final nsys profile brief6-restored-aa82f211.

Build a CUDA C++ specialized batched n=512 QR path that replaces the current panel/update route with a warp-tiled blocked Householder pipeline using shared-memory column tiles and fused norm/dot/update kernels, preserving existing dispatch predicates and leaving n176/n352/n4096 untouched.
add specialized n512 rankdef CUDA C++ path with per-column factor kernels and 12-column warp-per-column grouped updates; improves rankdef/clustered n512 cases
increase specialized n512 rankdef grouped update from 12 to 16 trailing columns with 512-thread warp-per-column blocks; valid and faster
increase specialized n512 rankdef grouped update to 20 trailing columns with 640-thread blocks; valid and faster
test specialized n512 rankdef grouped update at 24 trailing columns with 768-thread blocks; valid but slower than 20-column best

Brief 7 built a specialized CUDA C++ n512 rankdef QR path while preserving dispatch predicates and leaving n176/n352/n4096 behavior untouched. Best commit 6d38a275 uses per-column factor kernels plus 20-column/640-thread warp-per-column grouped updates, improving metric to 79026.111 us vs parent 92459.101. Tested 12-column baseline grouped update (85426.270), 16-column (82381.417), 20-column best (79026.111), and 24-column (79427.843, slower). Captured final nsys profile brief7-n512-6d38a275.

Micro-tune only de434's n512 rankdef CUDA C++ grouped-update path around the 20-column/640-thread winner: profile occupancy/register pressure/memory efficiency, then test nearby width x block-size variants such as 21/22 columns with 608/672/704 threads, preserving n32/n176 splits, aa82 n352, n1024/n4096 dispatch, and materialization.
test de434 n512 rankdef grouped update at 21 trailing columns with 672-thread blocks; valid but near parent
test de434 n512 rankdef grouped update at 22 trailing columns with 704-thread blocks; valid and slightly faster than 20-column parent
test de434 n512 rankdef grouped update at 19 trailing columns with 608-thread blocks; valid but slower than 22-column best

Brief 8 micro-tuned de434's n512 rankdef grouped-update path only. Tested nearby width/thread variants: 21 columns/672 threads (79240.557 us), 22 columns/704 threads (78767.027 us, best), and 19 columns/608 threads (78970.794 us). Preserved n32/n176 splits, aa82 n352, n1024/n4096 dispatch, and materialization. Branch left at best commit 99831732; final profile saved as brief8-n512-99831732.nsys-rep.

Graft only 9983173's n512 grouped-update retune onto 801146: change n512 from 20-column/640-thread to 22-column/704-thread only if the patch touches n512 grouped-update constants or launch parameters. Preserve 801146's n352 16-column/512-thread path, n32/n176 launch splits, n1024/n2048/n4096 dispatch, and materialization; reject any donor changes outside n512.
graft only 998317 n512 grouped-update constants onto 801146: 22-column/704-thread n512 update while preserving 801146 n352 16-column path and all other dispatch

Brief 9 grafted only 9983173's n512 grouped-update retune onto 801146. The patch changed only N512_GROUP 20->22 and N512_BLOCK 640->704 in submission.py, preserving 801146's n352 16-column/512-thread path, n32/n176 splits, n1024/n2048/n4096 dispatch, and materialization. Validation/guards passed; benchmark metric 78924.302 us. Final profile saved as brief9-combine-717a6a27.nsys-rep.

Micro-tune only current-best CUDA/C++ host dispatch and output materialization overhead for the existing n32/n176/n352/n512 custom paths: profile extension route selection plus H/tau allocation/fill, then remove redundant C++ checks, zero/empty fills, or wrapper launches while preserving identical route predicates, QR algorithms, kernel constants, and n1024/n2048/n4096 behavior.
remove redundant C++ wrapper checks and avoid redundant n352/n512 tau full-zero fills while preserving predicates/kernels/constants and larger-shape dispatch
